items.title: Johnny St. Cyr Interview, 1958-08-27
items.q: He was the clarinet player in the Olympia band when they first started... I think he went back to the Imperial with Manuel.

ctx.x: And the Imperial was Manuel Perez.

Manuel Perez, George Fields, Octave Gaspar, and Vic Gaspar. No, no, George Fields, Vic Gaspar was playing with him, George Fields playing, I think O. Gaspar was playing. No, Vic and Oak was playing with John Robichaud. Yeah. Who was the clarinet?
